$$

$$

$$
S_{\text{odd}} = \frac{100}{2}(2 \cdot 1 + (100 - 1) \cdot 2) = 50(2 + 198) = 50 \cdot 200 = 10000
$$

Now, to find what percent the even sum is of the odd sum:

$$
\text{Percent} = \left( \frac{S_{\text{even}}}{S_{\text{odd}}} \right) \times 100 = \left( \frac{10100}{10000} \right) \times 100 = 101\%
$$

To determine if $ R $ is an equivalence relation, we need to check if it is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive.
